Watch 2015 Superhit Action Thriller Movie Ab Tak Chhappan 2 starring Nana Patekar, Ashutosh Rana, Gul Panag and Vikram Gokhale. Watch on your TV for the best experience.
Sadhu Agashe, a retired encounter specialist, faces a series of challenges after he returns to Mumbai to solve various criminal cases growing in the city.
Ab Tak Chhappan 2 is a 2015 Indian Hindi-language action thriller film directed by Aejaz Gulab and scripted by Nilesh Girkar. The film stars Nana Patekar in the lead role. It also stars Gul Panag, and Ashutosh Rana.
